name: button
description: A link or a button that looks like a button. A link when it has href.

label.description: The visible text. It is also the accessible name.

href.description: Makes it a link. Leave out for an action on the page.

variant.description: primary: the one main action in a section. secondary: everything else.

usage:
{% from "components/button.njk" import button %}
{{ button({ label: "See the work", href: "/work/" }) }}

name: card
description: Image (optional), title link, one line of text. Use inside .grid.

alt.description: Required when image is set. Empty string if decorative.

level.description: Heading level for the title. The look does not change.

usage:
{% from "components/card.njk" import card %}
{{ card({ title: "…", text: "…", href: "…" }) }}

name: siteHeader
description: Site name and main nav. Already in the base layout; do not add it to pages.

currentUrl.description: page.url. Sets aria-current on the matching link.
